name: World info
description: Gatekeeper teleport lists show the monster levels around each destination, e.g. 'Cruma Tower (40-47)' (EXTRAS_PLAN §4).

TeleportLevels.description: Add the monster level range to destination names in teleport lists.

Radius.description: Monsters spawned within this distance of the destination count.

MinSpawns.description: Fewer monster spawns around: no range shown.

LowPercentile.description: Range from this percentile of monster levels (drops rare low outliers).

HighPercentile.description: Range up to this percentile of monster levels (drops rare high outliers).
